changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO themes ( tenant_id, name, is_active, primary_color, secondary_color, accent_color, background_color, text_color, sidebar_bg_color, sidebar_text_color, sidebar_active_color, sidebar_hover_color, header_bg_color, header_text_color, footer_bg_color, footer_text_color, surface_color, border_color, hover_color, link_color, error_color, success_color, warning_color, info_color, font_family, font_url, border_radius, dark_mode, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT id, 'Navy Blue', true, '#1a237e', '#ffffff', '#1e3a8a', '#f1f5f9', '#0f172a', '#1e293b', '#f8fafc', '#334155', '#475569', '#ffffff', '#0f172a', '#ffffff', '#64748b', '#ffffff', '#e2e8f0', '#f8fafc', '#2563eb', '#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#f59e0b', '#3b82f6', 'Inter', 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap', '0.5rem', false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tenants WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM themes WHERE themes.tenant_id = tenants.id );
